title: Machine learning predicts aggregate-state optical properties of molecules (AIE and ACQ)
summary: The authors built a database of literature molecules showing aggregation-induced emission or aggregation-caused quenching and trained an ensemble of multi-modal ML models to predict this behavior from molecular descriptors. Predictions were checked on three newly designed molecules, with reasonable consistency between predicted and experimental outcomes. The abstract reports no numeric performance values.
